sourceObservations: The original is a broad one-cell slate mass, with a slightly asymmetric eight-corner ground outline, a large uneven triangulated crown, and substantial vertical lower facets. It is a squat irregular rock, not a rounded pebble or a separate raised platform.

All four original captures show blue-gray slate color, a fine dark shallow top fissure that rotates with the rock, and lower side planes falling into very dark blue near the base. The crown reads as a broad smooth polygon at game scale; its modest facet variation is easy to lose.

The native builder explicitly authors an eight-point ground outline spanning X/Y -0.5 to 0.5, an uneven crown with maximum Z 0.48, and a shallow narrow fissure. Those source features establish identity and dimensions more reliably than the generated target.
targetObservations: The fixed target suggests softer broad illumination, readable gray-blue planar volume, quieter surface mottling, and restrained warm edge highlights.

Its beige crown and stronger carved-looking fissure are noticeably more emphatic than the source. Its altered silhouette and apparent surface complexity are aesthetic suggestions only; they do not authorize geometric drift, a wider/deeper split, or a beige rock.
The most valuable change is to make the original rock feel softly lit and tactile while retaining its subdued slate palette, original large-scale facets, and fine fissure.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: Lift the crushed dark lower facets into readable slate-gray volume with soft neutral light; keep crown, bevel transitions, sides and base distinct across all four rotations.
Add restrained broad facet-to-facet surface variation and gentle edge response so the crown has warm soft cartoon depth without becoming noisy, glossy, beige or rounded.
Retain the original asymmetry, footprint, uneven crown, fine shallow top fissure and registration; every view should remain recognizably the same actual rock.

technicalEvidence.checked: Read registered source camera, asset, rig and catalog records; inspected all four original native sprite files; read the native _slate builder for source form/height/fissure identity.
technicalEvidence.contract: Four static native rotations N/E/S/W, 384x704 capture frames, 192x352 logical frames, logical root [96,248], sourceScale 2, 128 logical pixels/cell, footprint [1,1], height 0.48, orthographic registered square-top/front camera and pixel aspect; no animation or sockets.
technicalEvidence.lighting: No preferred horizontal light direction and no directional ground cast shadow. Different side values caused by actual facet normals are acceptable; a persistent bright-left/dark-right treatment baked into the view is not.
technicalEvidence.limits: No edited Blender scene or candidate has been received. Native camera, bounds, root and dependency validation must accompany candidate review. This initial inspection does not approve any export.
